description: Generate chord progressions by key and mood, see the chords with roman numerals, and hear each one played.

faqs.a: Happy, Sad, Epic, Chill, Jazzy and Dark — each mood has hand-picked progression patterns that are transposed to your key with real music theory.
Chords are built from your key using proper harmonization (major/minor/diminished triads and 7ths), then played with a WebAudio synth.
No — everything is synthesized live in your browser.

howto: Pick a key and a mood.
Click any chord chip to hear it, or "Play all" for the full sequence.
Try different keys to hear how the mood changes.
title: Chord Progression Generator
